BDI.note: The document states nothing on e-procurement.

facts.fact: BANCOBU launched instant international transfers on its eNoti platform on 1 August 2025 with Thunes, letting holders of a foreign-currency account send and receive money in 48 countries, with a Bank of the Republic of Burundi payment systems director present.

BDI.note: The document states nothing on government payments to people.

The service is a bank-app foreign transfer, not a Burundian mobile money or wallet service.
The document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
